subtitle: Menschenrechte, Freiheit & Gerechtigkeit — Dokumentation von Menschenrechtsverletzungen gegen die Gülen‑Bewegung
theme: Light theme with high-contrast Anthracite structural frames, Deep Navy editorial accents, and warm legal paper backgrounds. Evokes serious investigative journalism, judicial authority, and archival integrity.

typography.mono_meta_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

rules.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
rules.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

grid_modes.hero_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 items-stretch
grid_modes.cards_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8
grid_modes.links_button_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4

key_sections.name: HERO Bereich
key_sections.description: Powerful editorial banner with title 'JusticeSquare – Menschenrechte, Freiheit & Gerechtigkeit', subtitle 'Dokumentation von Menschenrechtsverletzungen gegen die Gülen‑Bewegung', Justitia & world map graphic motifs, quick statistics ticker, and quick-jump navigation buttons to the 4 main sections (NEWS, REPORTS, INFOGRAFIKEN, MULTIMEDIA).
key_elements: Brand Badge: Verein Logo / Menschenrechtsinitiative
Hero Title & Subtitle with Serif typography
Section Quick-Jump Pills (NEWS, REPORTS, INFOGRAFIKEN, MULTIMEDIA)
Hero Background: Subtle watermarked Justitia scale & globe overlay gradient
Live Fact Stats Row: Total documented arrests, ECtHR judgments, NGO reports count

key_sections.name: NEWS (Aktuelle Nachrichten & Berichterstattung)
key_sections.description: Fact-based news cards with title, date, verified source, 3-4 sentence neutral journalistic summary, source credibility tag, and direct link to original article.
key_elements: Filter/Search bar for news topics & keywords
Card with date in mono font, source tag, headline, summary paragraph
External source link button with explicit external link icon
Data attribute: data-testid='news-card-{id}'

key_sections.name: REPORTS (Berichte internationaler Organisationen)
key_sections.description: Curated findings from HRW (Human Rights Watch), Amnesty International, UN/UNHCR, Freedom House, ECtHR (EGMR), US State Department. Shows title, institution logo/badge, bullet-point key findings, specific relevance for the Gülen movement, and original PDF/web link.
key_elements: Institution Filter Tabs (Alle, HRW, Amnesty, UN, Freedom House, EGMR, US State Dept)
Structured Report Card: Header with Institution Badge & Year
Bullet Points of Key Evidence (Wichtigste Erkenntnisse)
Relevanz für die Gülen-Bewegung highlight callout box
Direct PDF / Citation link button
Data attribute: data-testid='report-card-{id}'

key_sections.name: INFOGRAFIKEN (Interaktive Daten & Diagramme)
key_sections.description: Interactive data charts using Recharts with hover tooltips, tab switching between key datasets (Festnahmen seit 2016, Folter- und Misshandlungsfälle, Urteile des EGMR, Internationale Reaktionen, Asylstatistiken in Europa).
key_elements: Dataset Selector Tabs (Festnahmen, Folterfälle, EGMR Urteile, Asyl Europa)
Interactive Area/Bar/Line Chart with custom dark blue / alert red tooltip
Interactive Metric Highlight Cards with hover lift
Download / Share graphic data snippet button
Data attribute: data-testid='infographic-chart-tab-{key}'

key_sections.name: MULTIMEDIA (Experteninterviews, Doku & Audio)
key_sections.description: Embedded YouTube expert interviews, documentary films, explainer videos (Erklärvideos), and audio statement players with speaker biography, duration, and German transcripts/summaries.
key_elements: Media Filter: Alle, Videos, Dokumentation, Audio-Statements, Experten-Interviews
Video Player Modal & Embedded Cards with custom play button overlay
Speaker info, organization affiliation, duration badge
Data attribute: data-testid='multimedia-card-{id}'

key_sections.name: NÜTZLICHE LINKS & DOKUMENTENDATENBANK
key_sections.description: Grid of clickable reference buttons for HRW, Amnesty, UN Human Rights Office, UNHCR, Freedom House, ECtHR, DW, TR724, Bold Medya, and ECtHR case law DB.
key_elements: Grid of authoritative portal buttons with institution logos/icons
Hover lift transition with external link indicator
Data attribute: data-testid='useful-link-button-{id}'

motion_and_interactions.scroll_animations: Staggered fade-up on viewport entry using motion.div
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Card subtle translate-y-1 lift with shadow-lg and border-slate-400 tinting
motion_and_interactions.chart_hover: Recharts animated active dot & custom styled high-contrast tooltip
motion_and_interactions.prefers_reduced_motion: Wrap framer-motion components with reduced motion checks

editorial_rules.tone: Neutral, fact-based, journalistically clean, no political slogans, clear separation of facts/analyses/opinions, always visible source citations.

data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, links, search input, tabs, filter pills, video triggers, modal closes) MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-section-news-button', data-testid='report-card-filter-hrw').
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the JusticeSquare microsite is integrated smoothly as a dedicated route/page or prominent feature within the association website.
Utilize Lucide-react icons (Scale, FileText, BarChart3, Video, ExternalLink, ShieldCheck, Bookmark, Filter, Search, Globe, ChevronRight).
Use Recharts or Shadcn Chart primitives for the Infographics section with clear interactive tooltips and German labels.
Implement tabbed filtering for Reports, News, and Multimedia sections for fast, friction-free exploration.
Follow WCAG AA contrast standards with deep anthracite (#0F172A) text on light paper (#F8FAFC / #FFFFFF) surfaces.
